fields.description: The Need this position describes. One row per Need.
fields.label: Departmental Need

fields.description: The accepted revision the position is about: the Need's current accepted revision when Planning last reported.
fields.label: Need Revision

fields.description: Whether the department owes an update for this accepted revision. Update required: the department's plan was accepted without it, so the department must create an update. After current submission: the plan was submitted before it was accepted, so it goes into an update once Procurement accepts that submission.
fields.label: Position
fields.options:
No update needed
Update required
After current submission

fields.description: Planning's departmental plan reference. Stored as text, not a Link: Departmental Needs must not query Procurement Planning tables.
fields.label: Departmental Plan

fields.description: The earlier accepted revision the department's accepted plan still carries, when it carries one.
fields.label: Carried Revision

fields.description: The Planning change that produced this position.
fields.label: Source Event ID

fields.description: Orders updates so a late-arriving older position cannot overwrite a newer one.
fields.label: Source Event Time
